failures.fix: Check test logs for these two suites for auth/env errors and gate them on required secrets or fix the underlying assertion

failures.root_cause: Pipeline stage tests expect artifacts (plan.md, review.md) and non-zero exit paths that the mocked build/plan/review stages never write, and one intelligence test's jq call receives non-numeric complexity output
failures.fix: Fix mock stage scripts to write plan.md/review.md artifacts before stage completion and sanitize the complexity value passed to jq in the low-complexity intelligence test

failures.pattern: [2m  loop behavior: iterations on test failure[0m
failures.root_cause: sw-e2e-integration-test hit a stale/lock-held pipeline (pipeline-2742 already running) causing it to skip remaining assertions, while sw-intent-analysis-test's analyze_intent output is missing required schema fields (version, goal, criteria)
failures.fix: clear/reset the pipeline lock before the e2e-integration suite runs (or use a unique issue/lock id per test run) and update analyze_intent to always emit version, goal, and criteria fields in its JSON output

failures.root_cause: sw-loop-test and sw-intent-analysis-test fail (exit 1) alongside an sw-e2e-integration-test timeout, indicating a regression or environment flakiness in the loop harness/intent-analysis modules rather than the reported single-suite FAIL count
failures.fix: Run scripts/sw-loop-test.sh and scripts/sw-intent-analysis-test.sh locally with verbose output to isolate the failing assertion, then patch the underlying script and re-run sw-test-all.sh
